The Collection

Each tie is named for the shelf it came off, not the label sewn inside. What you see is the whole run — once it's gone, that pattern doesn't come back.

On orders above ₹1,500 — if a pattern you want is out of stock, we'll head to the warehouse ourselves and call you, so you can pick a replacement in person instead of guessing from a photo.

Keeping It

Silk remembers
how it's treated.

Roll, don't hang

Coil it loosely and store it flat. A hanger will eventually stretch the blade out of shape.

Steam, never iron

Heat direct from an iron flattens the weave. Hang it in a steamy bathroom instead and let it fall.

Loosen before you lift it off

Reverse the knot instead of pulling it over your head — it's the single biggest reason silk wears thin early.

Let it rest

Give a tie a day off between wears. The creases at the knot need time to relax back out.
